## Catan Game Overview
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/dice-5.svg
Catan (formerly "Settlers of Catan") is a popular board game where players compete to build the largest civilization on the fictional island of Catan. The core objective is to be the first player to reach **10 Victory Points (VPs)** by strategically settling, building, and trading resources.

## Game Setup and Core Gameplay
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/hexagon.svg
The game board is made up of hexagonal tiles representing different terrain types (forest, hills, pastures, fields, mountains) that produce resources (wood, brick, wool, grain, ore). Each tile has a number token, and when that number is rolled on two dice, the adjacent settlements and cities produce the corresponding resource.

-   **Resource Production**: On your turn, you roll two dice. The sum determines which hexes produce resources. Players with settlements or cities adjacent to these hexes collect the resources.
-   **Actions**: After collecting resources, you can perform actions:
    -   **Building**: Spend resources to build roads, settlements, and cities.
    -   **Trading**: Trade resources with other players, or with the bank (at a less favorable rate).
    -   **Development Cards**: Purchase special cards that can grant VPs, knight cards (to move the Robber), or progress cards.
-   **The Robber**: If a 7 is rolled, no resources are produced. Instead, the player who rolled the 7 moves the Robber to any hex, blocking its production, and steals a resource card from a player adjacent to that hex. If you have more than 7 resource cards when a 7 is rolled, you must discard half of them.

## Achieving Victory in Catan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/trophy.svg
To win, you must be the first player to accumulate 10 Victory Points (VPs). Here's how VPs are typically earned:

-   **Settlements**: Each settlement is worth 1 VP.
-   **Cities**: Upgrade a settlement to a city for 2 VPs.
-   **Longest Road**: The first player to build a continuous road of at least 5 segments, and longer than any other player's road, earns 2 VPs.
-   **Largest Army**: The first player to play 3 "Knight" development cards, and have more knights than any other player, earns 2 VPs.
-   **Development Cards**: Some development cards grant immediate VPs when revealed.

## Key Strategies for Success
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/lightbulb.svg
-   **Optimal Placement**: Your starting settlements are crucial. Aim for hexes with high-probability numbers (6s and 8s) that produce a variety of resources. Connecting to a port can also be very beneficial for specific trading.
-   **Resource Diversification**: Try to get access to all five resources (wood, brick, wool, grain, ore) to avoid being completely reliant on trades.
-   **Early Road Building**: Roads are cheap and allow you to expand, claim new settlement spots, and potentially earn the Longest Road bonus.
-   **Strategic Trading**: Don't be afraid to trade! Negotiate with other players to get the resources you need, even if it means giving them something useful. Avoid making one player too powerful.
-   **Development Cards**: Don't underestimate development cards. Knights can protect you from the Robber or steal resources, while VPs can be a surprise win condition.
-   **Robber Management**: Use the Robber to your advantage by placing it on hexes that benefit your opponents most, especially those with high-probability numbers or the player currently in the lead.

-   Watch a "How to Play" video: [Button: Catan Tutorial] https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ht2-31W36_A
